purpose: Teach: 門真/三谷/上村/奥山/二宮/坂田/西岡/西山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、門真キャンパスの研究員と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — collaborate with the researchers at the Kadoma campus.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Open with Ren's name as a clear signal of assignment. Steady pace, slight emphasis on the action word. No softening—this is a task, delivered with the quiet authority that doesn't need volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。三谷教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Mitani's papers.
lines.style: Respectful, forward-leaning. Slight acceleration on the action items to show engagement. Quiet but present—not tentative, not rehearsed. The voice of someone ready to move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の上村先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — contact Dr. Uemura about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Even steadier now. Name first, action second. Businesslike but not cold. Breath comes from the diaphragm—this person knows their authority and doesn't perform it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で奥山助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll attend Dr. Okuyama's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Earnest nod in the voice. Slightly faster than before but still measured. Shows he's taking notes mentally as he goes. A young researcher affirming each step of the path.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の二宮先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — refer to Dr. Ninomiya's papers in the literature review as well.
lines.style: Same tempo as before but with a slight weight on the addition—"as well" carries the emphasis. Not piling on, just building the map. Eyes-level delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の坂田先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask the senior members in the lab for guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly more formal here because he's naming a hierarchy. Breath flows naturally. Shows he understands the chain and the asking-permission tone that comes with it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の西岡教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — meet with Professor Nishioka about the international partnership.
lines.style: Slight shift in weight—this is bigger in scope. Name first, clear assignment. Deliberate pace. The international piece carries a little more gravity without needing to be said.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、西山事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to the research fund office through Nishiyama.
lines.style: Alert and efficient. Picks up the procedural thread immediately. Voice settles into the practical detail of it—this is the implementation layer. Quiet confidence, trailing softly on the name.
